name: Exp_DEMA_Range_Channel_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades breakout entries based on the Double EMA (DEMA) Range Channel indicator, opening positions when price breaks above or below the channel boundaries. It includes a time-based trade management filter (Tm) that restricts trading to specific hours, plus additional risk controls such as trailing stops and breakeven functionality.
summary_zh: 该EA基于双重EMA(DEMA)范围通道指标进行突破交易，当价格突破通道上下边界时开仓。内置基于时间的交易管理过滤器(Tm)，限制仅在特定时段交易，并附带移动止损和保本等附加风控功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于DEMA范围通道的突破交易系统。DEMA相比普通EMA响应更快，通道上下轨构成动态支撑阻力区域。入场条件：价格向上突破通道上轨时做多，向下突破下轨时做空，属于典型的区间突破策略。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、移动止损跟踪和保本止损功能，同时支持基于时间的自动平仓(Tm功能)，可限制交易时段或在指定时间强制平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和每日亏损限额等保护机制，但作为突破策略在震荡市中可能频繁出现虚假突破导致连续止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a breakout trading system based on the DEMA Range Channel. DEMA responds faster than standard EMA, and the channel boundaries form dynamic support and resistance zones. Entry conditions: go long when price breaks above the upper channel, go short when price breaks below the lower channel, representing a classic range breakout approach. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss, trailing stop tracking, and breakeven functionality, along with time-based forced closing (Tm feature) that can restrict trading hours or close positions at specified times. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management provides maximum position limits and daily loss caps as protective mechanisms, though as a breakout strategy it may suffer frequent false breakouts in ranging markets leading to consecutive stop-losses.

pros: DEMA指标相比普通EMA响应更快，能更及时捕捉趋势变化
内置时间过滤器有效避免低流动性时段的虚假突破
提供多层次出场机制(止盈止损+移动止损+保本)，风控体系较为完善
pros_en: DEMA indicator responds faster than standard EMA, capturing trend changes more promptly
Built-in time filter effectively avoids false breakouts during low-liquidity sessions
Multi-layer exit mechanism (TP/SL + trailing stop + breakeven) provides comprehensive risk control
cons: 突破策略在震荡行情中容易遭受频繁虚假突破导致连续亏损
未内置点差过滤器，在高点差时段入场成本可能过高
通道参数固定，缺乏自适应机制应对市场波动率变化
cons_en: Breakout strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No built-in spread filter, entry costs may be excessive during high-spread periods
Fixed channel parameters lack adaptive mechanism for changing market volatility
improvements: 增加波动率自适应机制，根据ATR动态调整通道宽度和止损距离
添加点差过滤和震荡市识别模块，减少不利市场条件下的交易频率
improvements_en: Add volatility adaptation using ATR to dynamically adjust channel width and stop-loss distance
Add spread filter and ranging market identification module to reduce trading frequency under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中缺乏有效过滤机制，可能连续触发止损
时间过滤器虽然存在但默认可能未启用，低流动性时段交易风险增加
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy lacks effective filtering in ranging markets, may trigger consecutive stop-losses
Time filter exists but may be disabled by default, increasing risk during low-liquidity sessions
